runtime_profile.memory_semantics: 50 ms process RSS samples, including other jobs; not an exclusive allocation peak
runtime_profile.process_tree_memory_semantics: 1 s parent plus descendant RSS sums (also at start/finish); shared pages may be counted more than once; includes other jobs; incomplete snapshots excluded. Private bytes, when available, are Windows private commit, not resident RAM.

memory_accounting.worker_samples_note: The last 16 samples may mix full and incremental readings. When residency_credit_eligible is false, unique_resident_bytes=0 means not measured for credit, not zero unique RAM. Calibrate residency only from complete samples with residency_credit_eligible=true.
memory_accounting.commit_policy: Expand only after observed system backing-limit growth; initial physical/user/scheduler caps and live checks still apply.
memory_accounting.ownership: Weak run-owned references; no parent-process growth credit after request overlap.
memory_accounting.worker_policy: Scheduler reservations and worker growth allowances remain enforced.
